keyFindings.description: A placement whose prefix or suffix is empty (the quote starts or ends its block, e.g. a whole heading, list item or table cell) matches any text on that side in surroundedBy (:279-283). Two readings then answer 'ambiguous' ('the same text around them'), which is false. The same cause at :461, outside the round cap: with the reader's block deleted and one unrelated reading elsewhere, the re-mark silently moves the comment to a passage the reader never selected (reproduced by deep-review: 'jumps over the lazy dog' / 'I saw it jumps over the lazy dog today.', first paragraph deleted -> mark on the second). Fix: an empty side shorter than QUOTE_CONTEXT_CHARS must sit at a block edge.

reanchor now awaits whenBridgeBinds (up to 10 s), and nothing marks the recovery as running. Meanwhile the composer shows the raw server sentence with Retry. A Retry that is refused again starts a second reanchor, both run when the bridge binds, two marks are written, and m-2 is left in the document with no record (reproduced by both reviewers). Fix: after the await, return unless the store's current entry is still refused for anchor.mark_id, and use that entry's request in readdress.
